lines.en: Four hooves on the mountain path.
Human half above, horse below.

lines.zh: 鬃毛被山风吹成一缕一缕。
lines.en: The mountain wind combs my mane into strands.
The mountain wind parts my mane.
I walk around a great boulder.

lines.zh: 蹄声在尖峭山峰间回响。
lines.en: Hooves echo among the peaks.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看看有没有动静。
lines.en: I lift my head to check for movement.
I cross the conifer floor.
The saddle straps move on my back.

lines.zh: 我沿着锚点附近转一圈。
lines.en: I circle near my anchor.
Loose stone rolls from my hooves.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的沟里穿过去。
lines.en: I cross the badland gully.
I walk slow, disturbing nothing.
I head downslope.
I stand, forehoof pawing.
Clean air up here.
My four hooves strike the mountain trail.
The saddle on my back is empty.

lines.zh: 我以前在别的地方游荡。
lines.en: I used to roam elsewhere.
I rest a hand on the saddle.
Wind snaps my clothing.

lines.zh: 我把鞍上的灰扫了一遍。
lines.en: I brush the dust off my saddle.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在石上很稳。
lines.en: My hooves are sure on stone.

lines.zh: 针叶林的味道我很喜欢。
lines.en: I like the smell of conifers.
I turn my head slowly.
I count stones on the ridge.
The dark forest is too dark.
I breathe out a plume.
A centaur body can carry you.
The saddle is not decoration.

lines.zh: 你要骑我，得先踩上石头。
lines.en: To ride me, you must first step onto a stone.
Centalmon, a Champion.
Do you have reins?

lines.zh: 你手里没缰绳，蹄子就不动。
lines.en: No reins in your hand, so my hooves stay put.
You look like you could stay on.
The path is narrow. Do not ride abreast.
I know the taming gesture.
Do you want me to guard you?
Sit down first. Then I decide.

lines.zh: 我的四蹄可以踩平石头。
lines.en: My hooves can flatten stone.

lines.zh: 你身上没有数码兽的气。
lines.en: You carry no digimon aura.
I wait for a rider.
You stand too far back.

lines.zh: 你的手心有草和铁的味道。
lines.en: Your palm smells of grass and iron.
A bit of my data breaks off.

lines.zh: 鞍带松了一格，数据碎了一点。
lines.en: A saddle strap loosens and a bit of data breaks off.
The saddle straps jolt.
My mane is pulled askew.
I snort and steady.
The strap is loose. It does not matter.
That hit the horse half.
Still here. Data intact.
I edge back toward the rock.

lines.zh: 我四蹄踏在山道上，这一下很重。
lines.en: Four hooves on the mountain path; that blow was heavy.
I absorb this data.

lines.zh: 你举的那块数据，我看不清。
lines.en: I cannot make out that lump of data you hold up.
Food does little for me.
Data suits me better than grass.

lines.zh: 你举得太高了，我看不清。
lines.en: Too high. I cannot see it.
That will carry me a day.
Do not coax me. I am not dull.

lines.zh: 放下，我自己会拿，数据比草对我胃口。
lines.en: Set it down; I will take it myself — data suits me better than grass.
Not quite enough.
Steady hands. Good.

lines.zh: 这块数据我咽下去，还差一点。
lines.en: I swallow this data and it is still not enough.
You smell familiar.
You hit my horse half.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子比你整个人重。
lines.en: My hoof outweighs you.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你就贴过来了。
lines.en: I turn and you press in.
Not behind me. I kick.
Four hooves plant and hold.
Gravel scatters under us.

lines.zh: 碰撞不算什么，我很结实。
lines.en: A bump means nothing. I am solid.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的马身，碎石飞起来。
lines.en: You hit my horse body and gravel sprays up.
You hit hard too.
The saddle strap is knocked askew.
Digimon do not discuss that.
I think of evolution and battle.
That is a very human question.

lines.zh: 我的数据里没有这一项。
lines.en: That is not in my data.

lines.zh: 我低头刨了刨地，没接你的话。
lines.en: I paw at the ground and do not answer you.
Ask no more. The wind takes it.
I would rather become Saggitarimon.
Ask how to ride me instead.
I do not take that topic.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，往山脊那头走。
lines.en: I flick my tail and walk off along the ridge.
I pick up this data.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我用蹄拨过来。
lines.en: I nudge your dropped thing over.
I bend. Steady.
Too heavy. I drag it.
It fell into a rock crack.
I hang it from the saddle.
This data is not clean.
You take it. My hooves are clumsy.
Yours. I will not take it.
I can carry it.
Something moves on the ridge.
I raise a forehoof to charge.

lines.zh: 我锁定那个方向，四蹄已经压紧。
lines.en: I lock that direction; four hooves dig in.
My move is ready.

lines.zh: 超级爆破已经对准你的胸口。
lines.en: Mega Blaster is aimed at your chest.
I do not want this. You block me.
One stride. Loud hooves.
This move is Mega Blaster.
Distance measured. Enough.
Hear the hooves quicken?
I wait for the first blow.
I raise my forelegs and charge.
I work along the ridge.

lines.zh: 我在数山道的转弯，第三个。
lines.en: I count the turns of the mountain path; the third.

lines.zh: 山道窄，我的四蹄已经占满。
lines.en: The mountain path is narrow and my four hooves fill it.
I wait for you to leave the rock.
The path is narrow.

lines.zh: 人马一齐伏低，鞍带在响。
lines.en: Both halves of me lower and the saddle straps creak.

lines.zh: 我的右手先抬，蹄子随后。
lines.en: My right hand rises first; my hooves follow.
Hear the gravel rolling?
One step more and you are underhoof.
Armor stops no hoof.
Two steps left. Weight low.

lines.zh: 蹄声一停，就是出手的时候。
lines.en: When the hooves stop, I strike.
My forehooves come down.
Mega Blaster, dead on.

lines.zh: 人马一齐压上去，你退了。
lines.en: Man and horse press; you give way.
My human hand shoves you off.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在石上，碎石飞起。
lines.en: Hooves strike stone; shards fly.
You stopped the hooves, not the hand.
Textbook form.
Half horse, built to carry a rider.
A centaur body runs steady.
My hoof only grazed you.
I have more left.

lines.zh: 我借着坡势冲下，蹄声成片。
lines.en: I charge down the slope with a drumroll of hooves.
Hooves on the mountain path.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，马蹄踩碎枯枝。
lines.en: In the pines, hooves snap the dry branches.

lines.zh: 尖峭山峰上多了个影子。
lines.en: A shape among the peaks.
I appear near my anchor.
Wind scatters my mane.
I crest the ridge and stop.

lines.zh: 你听见一声数码兽的鸣叫。
lines.en: A digimon call.
My data takes shape.
I patrol these heights.

lines.zh: 山下的路上，我看见了人。
lines.en: I see someone on the path.
I lift my head and stamp.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的沟里爬上来。
lines.en: I climb out of the badland gully.
The saddle strap is not tied yet.
Now I hold this pass.
Fire singes a patch of mane.

lines.zh: 我从崖边滑下去，摔了一跤。
lines.en: I slide off the ledge and fall.
The current pulls at my legs.

lines.zh: 爆炸把碎石掀了我一身。
lines.en: The blast throws gravel over me.
An arrow in my flank.
Magic binds all four hooves.
Low data. I start to fade.

lines.zh: 雷打在尖峰上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning on the peak numbs me.
No mountain below. Nothing.
